facts.value: Board P r3 Q1 DMP3036SFG-7: VBEN-driven P-channel output load switch, source VBUS_P, drain VBUS_OUT, gate Q1_G; adopted in board_p_spec.py and the routed r3 PCB, replacing the historical AO3401A
facts.conditions: Project-state refresh 2026-11-09: R11 source-to-gate is 150k and R12 gate-to-VBEN is 4.7k; D8 and D13 BZT52C11-7-F clamps are parallel, cathodes on VBUS_P and anodes on Q1_G. This supersedes the old 100k/150k and -2.0 V at 5 V description. C36/Q5 provide the separately conditioned soft-start path. Datasheet current ratings require their stated 1 in2 2 oz copper, not arbitrary r3 copper. At 5 A and 29 mOhm, 0.725 W is a desk estimate under the -5 V/25 C RDS(on) condition, not a measured loss or thermal rating. R3 layout corrections and native acceptance are tracked separately; thermal and SOA/linear-mode behavior remain conditional and physically unmeasured.
